narrative.overview:
Prior Auth Express looks like a printed clinical record that the nurse fills in. Each case is a ruled form: policy criteria run down the rows, submitted documents run across the columns, and each cell holds a charting-ink entry that shows where the evidence lives. The page is cool white, text is blue-black ink, thin gray rules make every box, blue marks action and selection, and orange marks only exceptions.

Density is high and calm for a full shift. Fixed stations keep their place: app bar, patient banner, lifecycle stamps, grid, decision column, sign-off strip. Empty states are designed absence, never illustration. The system refuses KPI tiles, card stacks, and pill soup; depth comes from rules and tonal fills, not shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled cells and boxed fields with caption labels inside each box
Achromatic text; only abnormal values take color
One legible sans with tabular numerals
Nearly square corners (2px), 1px rules, flat surfaces
State tints of 120 to 200 ms; instant under reduced motion

rules.name: The Abnormal-Only Rule
rules.body: Color never marks a normal value. Met stays in ink. Only Not met, Insufficient, overdue, and urgent take orange.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue means action or selection. Orange means exception. No third accent; no success green.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number, date, time, ID, code, and countdown uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Caption-Inside Rule
rules.body: A caption label names the value in its own box. It never floats above a heading.

rules.name: The Ruled-Not-Raised Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. Separate regions with a rule or a tonal fill. The toast lift is the only shadow.

rules.name: The Selection Underline Rule
rules.body: A 2px inset bottom underline in the action color marks a lit column header and the next lifecycle stamp. It is the same family as the 3px top bar on a selected tab. Side stripes stay banned.

dos: Do put every secondary task in an inline disclosure next to its trigger.
Do keep motion between 120 and 200 ms and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep the SLA countdown in the Decision due box of every case banner.
Do offer only Approve, Request information, and Refer to MD; possible denials go to an MD.
Do show a letter as read-only once it is marked ready.
Do show “Demo — synthetic data, no PHI” in the app bar.
Do mark selection with blue fills, rings, the tab top bar, and the 2px blue bottom underline on lit column headers and the next lifecycle stamp.
donts: Don't use modals, dialogs, or side panels.
Don't add a deny button, deny state, or automated deny path.
Don't stack a small label above a heading.
Don't use colored side borders wider than 1px or inset side stripes.
Don't use offset or hard block shadows.
Don't use pill shapes or card treatments.
Don't color a normal value or add a success green.
Don't name any vendor, guideline publisher, or product family; policies are public CMS NCDs and LCDs.
